# onetsolutions_domain_availability (Data Source)

Checks whether a domain name can be registered, and at what price.

The answer is read at each refresh and may change at any time: `onetsolutions_domain` checks
the name again when it plans a registration, and refuses a name that is not available. A premium
name, priced by its registry, is reported as not available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_domain_availability" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

output "registrable" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_domain_availability.example.available
}

output "first_year_price" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_domain_availability.example.price
}

output "alternatives" {
  value = [for s in data.onetsolutions_domain_availability.example.suggestions : "${s.name} (${s.price} EUR)"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain name to check, lowercase without a trailing dot, such as `example.com`.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the name can be registered.
- `price` (String) The price of the first year of registration, in EUR, as a decimal string; null when the name is not available.
- `suggestions` (Attributes List) Available names close to `name`, when it is not available. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--suggestions))
- `tld` (String) The extension of the name, such as `com` or `co.uk`.

<a id="nestedatt--suggestions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `suggestions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The domain name.
- `price` (String) The price of its first year, in EUR, as a decimal string.
- `tld` (String) Its extension.
